original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Specialized optical/volume intent remains dependent on matching scene media and geometry.
Native GPU realization uses a finite rectangular emitter; a directional/spot angular model is retained as intent, not silently equated to a measured fixture.
Requires an explicitly bound volume/material; the light asset does not silently add an atmosphere or a water medium.
